notes.title: Update notes: 7/24/24
notes.content:
This update switches to using Unity's Universal Rendering Pipeline - primarily to create the underwater caustics for the Ocean level, but it will surely be utilized in future updates.

This update includes the Sky and Ocean level with placeholder music.
